name: ch4_fig13_oxygen_comparison
prompt: Title (top, Korean and English on separate lines with no plus sign): "호기와 혐기 조건 비교" and smaller warm-grey "Aerobic vs Anaerobic". Two aligned panels share top tag "포도당·목적함수 동일". Left panel title "A" "호기": one input "포도당", one green incoming arrow "산소", and a visibly larger blue bar "성장"; any product arrows are unlabeled abstract lines. Right panel title "B" "혐기": the same input "포도당", the incoming "산소" arrow blocked by one red X, a visibly smaller blue bar "성장", and exactly three outgoing arrows labeled "아세테이트", "에탄올", and "포름산". Do not draw or label water, carbon dioxide, chemical formulae, or a separate comparison heading. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every panel tag, bar, arrow, molecule icon, and marker has one perfectly uniform solid fill. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no other text, symbols, molecular formulae, or labels.
